rationales: Momentum is not the contact force that lets a runner push against the ground.
Weight acts downward and does not provide the needed backward push.
Acceleration describes a change in velocity, not the force enabling the push.
Friction lets the runner push the ground backward and receive a forward force.
Nm⁻¹ is not the SI unit of torque.
Nm² is not the SI unit of torque.
Nm⁻² is not the SI unit of torque.
Torque is force multiplied by perpendicular distance, so its SI unit is Nm.
Potential energy is associated with position or configuration, not motion.
The energy a body has due to its motion is kinetic energy.
Power is the rate of doing work, not energy due to motion.
Velocity is a measure of motion, not the work-related energy of the body.
One horsepower is approximately 746 watts.
476 watts is not the standard conversion for one horsepower.
647 watts is not the standard conversion for one horsepower.
674 watts is not the standard conversion for one horsepower.
The opposing pulls do not make the tension zero; the string is stretched.
The tension is not half the applied force in this setup.
The tension is not 10 N when each end is pulled with 20 N.
The tension in the string equals the pull at either end, so it is 20 N.
Perpendicular forces do not by themselves define a couple.
Like parallel forces act in the same direction and do not form a couple.
Equal and opposite forces on the same line cancel without producing a turning effect.
A couple consists of equal, opposite, parallel forces acting along different lines.
Using W = mgh gives about 100 J, not 10 J.
W = 2 × 10 × 5 = 100 J (approximately).
The calculated work is not 3.5 J.
The calculated work is not 1000 J.
The speed of light is not 3 × 10⁹ m s⁻¹.
The speed of light is not 3 × 10¹⁰ m s⁻¹.
The speed of light in vacuum is approximately 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹.
The speed of light is not 3 × 10¹⁸ m s⁻¹.
A water barometer needs a tube about 10.3 m long, so approximately 11 m is appropriate.
A 1 m tube is too short to support a water column at atmospheric pressure.
A 2.5 m tube is too short to support a water column at atmospheric pressure.
A 100 kg mass weighs about 160 N on the Moon, not 100 N.
The Moon’s gravity is about one-sixth of Earth’s, giving a weight near 160 N.
1000 N is approximately the weight on Earth, not on the Moon.
1600 N is much greater than the Moon weight of a 100 kg body.
The first condition of equilibrium is that the vector sum of forces is zero.
∑J = 0 is not the mathematical form of the first condition of equilibrium.
∑P = 0 is not the mathematical form of the first condition of equilibrium.
∑W = 0 is not the mathematical form of the first condition of equilibrium.
Power may be useful, but it is not the factor that provides grip while climbing.
Velocity is not what prevents slipping on a hill.
Speed is not what provides traction while climbing.
Friction provides grip between the feet and the surface, making it desirable when climbing.
S is not the quantity given by change in momentum divided by time.
Acceleration is change in velocity per unit time, not momentum per unit time.
Change in momentum per unit time equals force.
V is not the quantity given by change in momentum divided by time.
Displacement has both magnitude and direction, so it is a vector quantity.
Power has magnitude only and is a scalar quantity.
Time is a scalar quantity.
Distance is a scalar quantity.
A least count of 0.1 s is not typical of a commonly used digital stopwatch.
A commonly used digital stopwatch typically has a least count of 0.01 s.
A least count of 0.001 s is not the commonly stated value for these stopwatches.
A least count of 1 s is too coarse for a commonly used digital stopwatch.
